title: STC X LEXA
script:
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "STCSpamLoading"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- CoreGui safety check
if gethui then
    ScreenGui.Parent = gethui()
elseif syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui)
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
else
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
end

-- Loading Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 100)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.4, -50)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
UICorner.Parent = MainFrame

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "STC SPAM"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
Title.TextSize = 22
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = MainFrame

local SubTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SubTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
SubTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 55)
SubTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SubTitle.Text = "Loading STC SPAMER..."
SubTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
SubTitle.TextSize = 14
SubTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SubTitle.Parent = MainFrame

-- Original script load
task.spawn(function()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://scriptblox.com/raw/Brookhaven-RP-CTX-SPAMMER-OC3-228394"))()
    end)

    if not success then
        warn("Script load hone mein error aaya: " .. tostring(err))
    end
    
    -- Loading hide animation
    task.wait(1.5)
    TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Title, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(SubTitle, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.5)
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- UI Name & Branding Replacement Loop (STC SPAMER)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.2) do
        local function checkAndReplace(parent)
            pcall(function()
                for _, obj in pairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                        local t = obj.Text
                        if t and t ~= "" and t ~= "STC SPAMER" then
                            if t:find("CTX") or t:find("Ctx") or t:find("OC3") or t:find("SPAMMER") or t:find("SYSTEM") or t:lower():find("textbox") then
                                obj.Text = "STC SPAMER"
                            end
                        end
                        
                        if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                            local ph = obj.PlaceholderText
                            if ph and (ph:find("CTX") or ph:find("Ctx") or ph:find("OC3") or ph:find("SPAMMER") or ph:find("SYSTEM")) then
                                obj.PlaceholderText = "STC SPAMER"
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        pcall(function() checkAndReplace(CoreGui) end)
        
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if player then
            if player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
                checkAndReplace(player.PlayerGui)
            end
            if player.Character then
                checkAndReplace(player.Character)
            end
        end
        
        pcall(function() checkAndReplace(game:GetService("Workspace")) end)
    end
end)
features:
• Custom Loading Screen UI
• Brookhaven RP Spammer Script
• Auto UI Name & Branding Replacement (STC SPAMER)
• CoreGui Protection Support
